storage: 6 months or more; in Mumbai's humid monsoon months the fridge also keeps out ants and mould. Bring to room temperature or soak before use if they harden.
looksLike: Small, wrinkled, oval dried grapes, about 1–1.5 cm long. The everyday Indian kishmish (mostly from Nashik and Sangli in Maharashtra) is green-gold to light amber, soft and sticky, with no seeds.
shelfLife: About 6–12 months in a sealed pack (check the best-before date); 2–3 months once opened at room temperature.
substitutes: Dried cranberries or chopped dried apricots

usedIn.raw: 8 g (1 tbsp), stirred in the night before so they plump up and sweeten the jar
